question: Can a separately versioned analytic effective-mark-loss compiler remove P4E's Beer-Lambert area-mean bias while retaining local variance, deterministic partitions and the physical-domain controls?

compiler.base_gaussian_kernel: the normalized discrete separable Gaussian kernel with the profile sigma and truncate
compiler.compiled_gaussian_kernel: the normalized discrete separable Gaussian kernel with sigma/factor and the unchanged truncate
compiler.derivation: For independent Poisson arrivals, -log(E[transmittance]) equals rate times effective_mark_loss. The ratio maps the compiled field to the base-pitch area-reference expectation without per-image fitting.

branch_rule.pass: retain the effective-mark-loss compiler and open a separately frozen synthetic edge/nonstationarity stress before any photograph or product use
branch_rule.fail: close analytic effective-mark-loss LOD and retain P4D base-pitch evidence only

claim_ceiling: generic analytic physical-inspired LOD evidence; not measured film NPS, dye-cloud calibration, stock response or product evidence
